svg.title: CREBAIN native city environment and reconstructed branches
svg.desc: One metric scene supplies city colliders, meshes, and static Gaussian surfaces. Explicit physics ticks update complete CPU, acoustic, and thermal state. Configured RGB or thermal cameras select a private renderer. Without cameras, no graphics process starts and CPU observations still reach the lease. The owner accepts observations after complete source and time joins. Camera-based checkpoints reconstruct exact CPU state and verify fresh current pixels before admitting independent branches. This does not clone hidden GPU state.
svg.text: CREBAIN · A city, explicit time, actual observations
Standalone source component · +Y up, +Z forward · No neural controller or protocol bundle required
One owned metric SceneSpec
Authored cuboids → Rapier colliders, mesh surfaces, static Gaussians, acoustic obstruction, and thermal visibility
Complete CPU owner
Accepted action → controller → motors → actual Rapier
Pressure phases, delay rings, and seeded noise
Mechanical power → explicit heat balance → temperature
Executed time: tick k / 120 s · Acoustic samples: 16 kHz
Graphics: configured cameras only
Exact scene, tick, pose, and temperature inputs
Awaited Spark RGB: RGBA8 sRGB
Float thermal pixels: bolometric W/(m² sr)
Parent watchdog owns setup, capture, and cleanup
Accept one complete observation, then issue one immutable lease
Bind raw arrays and privileged reference separately. Failure retires the generation.
Fresh matched branch A
Exact CPU replay + current static-pixel equality
Fresh matched branch B
Own actions and lifetime · Shared initial noise state
Dashed links: checkpoint reconstruction at an all-camera barrier. Hidden GPU-state cloning and universal future equality are not claimed.
Dotted links: configured cameras only. Without cameras, graphics is null and CPU observations still reach the lease.
